text:
Jordan: Hi finance team — charged an annual airport lounge membership on the corporate card today. The vendor PDF only shows a total and vendor name, no itemized VAT breakdown. Amount: £199.99 GBP. Is this an allowed corporate expense and can we reclaim VAT?

Priya: Jordan, is this strictly for business travel (i.e., used for client meetings/trips) or a personal convenience? We need manager sign-off for recurring memberships.

Jordan: It's for regular client travel across EMEA — I use it for multiple client meetings and to host visiting partners. Priya approved verbally earlier but happy to add written note here.

Priya: Confirming approval: membership used for client travel and team visits. Approve corporate payment for FY travel allowances.

Nina: Thanks. Two things finance needs for VAT reclaim: (1) vendor invoice with VAT line and vendor VAT reg number, (2) business justification/manager approval attached. If vendor invoice lacks VAT, HMRC (or local tax authority) may not accept reclaim. Share the PDF link and vendor contact and we'll advise next steps.

Jordan: Uploaded receipt: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/lounge_annual_2026.pdf Vendor support: accounts@airportloungeplus.example Vendor VAT: not printed on PDF. Card posted at £199.99 and no FX fee (GBP card).

finance-bot: Automated checklist: required for membership VAT reclaim -> [original invoice with VAT breakdown, vendor VAT reg no, manager approval, business purpose]. Missing: VAT breakdown. If vendor cannot provide VAT invoice, classify as non-reclaimable and code to GL 6550 (Employee benefits / Travel misc).

Nina: If the vendor can provide a tax invoice on request, we can hold the expense in pending VAT reclaim status. Jordan, please email vendor support and request an itemized VAT invoice addressed to Redwood Inference Ltd (our billing address on file). Use the template: 

---
Subject: Request for VAT invoice 
Body: Hello Accounts team, please supply an itemized VAT invoice for transaction ref <TRANSACTION_ID> charged on <DATE> for £199.99 to Redwood Inference Ltd, VAT reg no: GB123456789, billing address: 120 Market St, SF. Thank you.
---

Jordan: Sent to accounts@airportloungeplus.example with transaction id LX-7734 and date 2026-03-20. Copy of my sent email: https://files.redwood.example/outbox/lounge_request_LX-7734.eml

Elaine: From Sales side, confirmed this is used by multiple team members for client work. Fine with company covering it and invoicing back to team budget if needed.

Nina: Ok. Interim step: submit expense in the portal as follows:
- Expense type: Membership / Subscriptions
- Amount: £199.99
- Paid by: Corporate card
- Attach: receipt PDF, manager approval (Priya screenshot), sent-email to vendor
- Temp GL: 6550 (Travel misc) and mark as "pending VAT reclaim"
If vendor provides VAT invoice we will move to GL 6105 and reclaim where applicable.

Jordan: Done  submitted at https://expenses.redwood.example/submit/2033612345 and attached Priya approval screenshot and sent-email.

finance-bot: Note: If vendor does not respond within 10 business days, finance will close the reclaim attempt and expense will remain non-reclaimable. Next steps: monitor vendor reply -> update expense record -> reclassify if VAT invoice received. Thread closed by finance-bot.
